description.value: A motel and RV park in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island's central coast. Offers overnight accommodation for touring cyclists and other travelers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website returned minimal content (just the page title), making bike storage, staff knowledge, and most amenities unverifiable from primary evidence. OSM confirms it's a real motel and RV park with free Wi-Fi available. The business appears legitimate, open, and publicly accessible; lack of confirmed cyclist-specific amenities does not warrant exclusion.
concerns: Website content minimal (84 bytes) — most amenities and services cannot be verified from web evidence; direct operator contact may be needed for bike storage and other details
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible accommodation business suitable for touring cyclists. Lack of website-verified amenity details does not warrant exclusion.
